The proposed technology consists of a dual-purpose (heating and cooling) thermal battery with room temperature thermal energy storage integrated with heat pump(s) (HPs) for residential and commercial applications. The battery serves as the heat reservoir, absorbing heat when operating as a condenser in cooling mode or rejecting heat when operating as an evaporator in heating mode. The main components include one compressor, two heat exchangers (HX), multiple expansion devices, and one thermal battery.
